_comment: C0-13 tongyi-wanxiang bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（jimeng/flux），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 有 4 项，related 键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。filing_name「通义万相大模型」属合法 B 类残留（官方登记名）。

axes.model_access: The Wanxiang (Wan) model series runs on two tracks: the product side (tongyi.aliyun.com/wanxiang) + open weights (the Wan-Video org on GitHub, the Wan-AI org on HF — both orgs direct-fetched 200 and verified). Product-side model tiers follow what the site displays; open weights can run locally via the runner/ComfyUI ecosystem (Apache-2.0 code verified).
axes.runtime: Web product + app; generation processed on Alibaba Cloud. The open line is its unique surface: the same model family can be chosen between the cloud product and a local deployment.
axes.local_files: On the product side, works and materials are stored in the cloud account; on the open line, weights and generated artifacts are entirely on your side — the two lines have completely different data boundaries.
axes.background: Product-side generation tasks queue in the cloud; on the open line, local runs are entirely determined by your own processes. No managed "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Capability lines inside the product: text-to-image, image-to-image, image editing, text-to-video/image-to-video (the Wan video line), etc.; Alibaba Cloud Model Studio provides the API line. MCP support — no official statement verified.
axes.context: The product side is organized by works; cross-session memory — no official statement verified. The open line has no memory surface (the model itself is stateless).
axes.permissions: Product-side account system (Alibaba account); the open line has no accounts. The training-use switch not verified line by line. The Wanxiang model's filing no. is in the cn block (Alibaba Cloud official disclosure).
axes.fit: Fits: wanting the "cloud product + open weights" dual track (compliance-sensitive scenarios can run locally), image+video in one family, Chinese semantics. Does not fit: wanting fully managed long tasks; wanting the product-side experience without the Alibaba account.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **The mapping between the product side's current model tiers and the open-source Wan versions** (version narratives lag each other)
- **The product side's training-use switch path**
- **The actually usable tier of open-source Wan2.2 on consumer GPUs** (belongs to the models/runner side measurements)
unknowns:
- The complete product-side model-tier list (follows what the site displays)
- License differences across the HF weight repos (per-repo model cards not verified item by item)
- The product-side training-use switch (not verified line by line)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both domestic image+video one-stop creation benches: Wanxiang has an open-weights line, Jimeng does not.
Both open-weight image-generation families: the FLUX weight family and the Wan weight family both run in the local ecosystem.
